# Transaction vectors: <label> <type> <sender> <hash> <canonical-rlp>
# All hex is without 0x. `sender` is `-` where the fixture omits it.

# element -- and is the EIP-2718 canonical form: for a typed transaction
# the RLP string's PAYLOAD (type||rlp(payload)), for a legacy one the
# list item itself.
#

# separately-decoded JSON fields were re-encoded by an implementation
# independent of the one under test and required to equal the slice.

#

# independent implementation, never by the code under test.
#

# canonical form; 3844 transactions were dropped by that cap.
# 35 distinct (type, creation, access-list, data,
# blob-hash, authorization) shapes were found and 35 kept.
